'''Hazefyre Tuskbeast''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A tuskbeast corrupted by hazefyre. These small aberrations usually move in packs and can pose a serious threat, even to fully armed field teams.}}

==Overview==
[[Wild Tuskbeast]]s that got completely corrupted by hazefyre, Hazefyre Tuskbeasts are slightly more threatening than their counterpart; They still attack with a bite or a leaping bite however, dealing Physical damage.
